cards.0905: At number ten a woman in her early thirties has three loose bricks at the end of the bed and means to slide the palm flat into the slit behind the middle brick with fingers together and thumb along its side and to find out how far the slit runs and what sits at its end. cards.0906: At number twelve a woman of seventy-eight has a stone trough at the side of the garden with a cleft under its rim and means to press the back of the wrist into that cleft with fingers curled back toward the forearm and to find out what the rim sits on and how deep the cleft goes. Nothing lifted nothing dug no room entered.
cards.0907: At number nine a woman in her late fifties has a fence rail of timber with a bored dowel hole in its end and means to push the thumb alone into that bore with fingers folded against the palm and to find out how deep it runs and what stops it. The rail not moved the hole not bored deeper the spanner not picked the coal not opened.
cards.0908: At the lock-up a woman in her late forties has a shutter guide of iron along the bay with a seam of rust at its foot and means to drive the outer edge of the hand down that seam with fingers straight and pressed together and to find out what the guide stands on and how far down it goes. Nothing lifted the shutter stays down the oval holes not filled or plugged.
cards.0909: At the unit a man in his early forties has a cupboard under the bench with a pocket of air behind its back board and means to walk the fingertips backward into that pocket with wrist bent and elbow raised and to find out what the back board rests against and how wide the pocket runs. cards.0910: At number ten a woman in her early thirties has two edging stones along the path with a groove of soil between them and means to run the knuckle side of the thumb along that groove with the hand on its side and to find out what lies under the groove and how much it gives. cards.0911: At the unit a man in his early forties has a sawn pile of offcuts at the back of the store with a split between two lengths and means to push the middle three fingers as a wedge into that split with outer fingers lifted clear and to find out what the split opens onto and how far it goes. No length moved no bar in the latch hooked the staple NOT DONE.
cards.0912: At the lock-up a woman in her late forties has a kerb of concrete at the mouth of the bay with a notch in its top and means to press the heel side of the thumb into that notch with fingers spread over the face and to find out what the notch sits over and how deep it runs. Nothing put in the notch the heap not touched the oval holes not filled or plugged.
cards.0913: At number twelve a woman of seventy-eight has a wall coping of brick with a channel of moss along its underside and means to draw the finger pads upward inside that channel with wrist turned outward and to find out what the coping covers and how far back the channel runs. Nothing lifted nothing planted no room entered.
cards.0914: At number nine a woman in her late fifties has a step of stone at the back with a crease of earth along its foot and means to pinch the edge of the thumb and the side of the forefinger into that crease and draw along and to find out what the step sits on and how far under it goes. The step not lifted the gate not touched the coal not opened.
